label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 17
title: MVP: intake follow-up + parked management + full intake lifecycle in the dashboard
body: The whole intake pipeline is in MVP, including management of follow-ups and parked items: conversations, extracted ideas/requirements/decisions, change packages, implementation plans, compile/approve, promotion to backlog (project OR Product Forge itself), and follow-up/parked handling (parked status, follow-up dates, reminders, snooze, promotion back to scheduled work). Ties to BI-0015 (surface all modules) and BI-0033/BI-0038 (dialogs).
